title: What does coherence mean in a world model?
summary: The model preserves consistent state, identity and relationships over time and action.
body: Coherence means maintaining stable entities, relationships and environmental state as time passes and viewpoints or actions change. A basic test is whether an object remains where it was placed after the observer leaves and later returns.
